trial_court: Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kangra, FIR No.183/2020
case_name: Arvind Dhiman v. State Of H.P. & Ors

parties.respondent_defendant: State of H.P. & Ors (wife, police, court)

facts_of_case: Petitioner's wife lodged a complaint and FIR was registered against him under Sections 498-A, 504 and 506 IPC. Police conducted investigation and submitted final report. Parties compromised and matter is pending before trial court.

legal_principles.principle: The primary purpose of law is to maintain peace in the society.
legal_principles.held: The primary purpose of law is to maintain peace in the society and when, the parties to the marriage, i.e. petitioner and respondent No. 2, have decided to part their ways by settling all the inter-se disputes, then, the continuation of the criminal proceedings, arising out of FIR in question, would certainly amount to abuse of the process of law.

legal_principles.principle: When parties settle their disputes, criminal proceedings should not continue.
legal_principles.held: The continuation of the criminal proceedings, arising out of FIR in question, would certainly amount to abuse of the process of law.

outcome.final_order: FIR No.183/2020 and proceedings resultant thereto are quashed.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for quashing FIR
